rationale: River water passes the condenser once and returns warmed, so almost all condenser heat reaches the river.
Closed loop: most heat leaves by evaporation to the air; only blowdown warms the river. Upper end of the 0-0.05 range.
Closed loop like a natural draught tower; fans only change how air moves through the tower. Upper end of the 0-0.05 range.
Dry cooling: heat goes to the air without cooling water.
No cooling system, so no heat reaches the river.
